name: What should I look for to ensure quality drywall sanding results?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for to ensure quality drywall sanding results?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure quality drywall sanding results, look for a surface that is uniformly smooth and free of visible ridges, bumps, or depressions. Run your hand across the sanded areas to feel for inconsistencies. Check for feathered edges where joint compound meets the existing drywall, ensuring no abrupt transitions. Good lighting, especially raking light (light shone parallel to the wall), will reveal imperfections that might be missed otherwise. A properly sanded surface will appear seamless and ready for priming without any noticeable texture variations from the drywall mud.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure quality drywall sanding by checking for uniformly smooth surfaces, feathered edges, and no visible imperfections. Use your hand and raking light to detect inconsistencies before priming.
